note: A3 (task-35 Part B): a STRING literal or a READER-CONDITIONAL node in the name position is not an identifier; the declaration publishes NO symbol and NO edge for it. Before the fix the node's text became a published name (`"bad docstring"`, `#?@(…)`) with exports+contains rows. Two-direction: the well-formed `ok-name` declaration keeps its symbol, export and containment.
